text_block_list.text:
"On the way back from our errand, we 
spotted a nice-looking cafe, so we decided 
to drop in for a break."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Oh, looks like this place is famous for 
crepes. Since we're here, maybe I'll get a 
crepe...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Trainer, which one will you go with?

Looking at the extensive menu, I struggled 
to decide what to order until the words 
'Limited Menu' caught my eye.
choice_data_list: I'll go with the strawberry crepe.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that sounds grand! Maybe I'll have 
that too.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that was delicious... Fufu, it had 
so many strawberries in it, it was really 
satisfying, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Just what I'd expect from my lucky item of 
the day.
choice_data_list:
Oh, so you care about lucky items and 
stuff?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah... well. It just happened to catch 
my eye this morning...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Look, if a lucky item can make you feel 
like 'Today's gonna be a happy day!', then 
it's totally worth it, right?
choice_data_list:
That's surprising. I didn't think you 
believed in that stuff.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Well, not so much now, but believe it or 
not, I used to believe in that quite a bit 
back in the day—"

text_block_list.name: Young Lala's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! Did you see this morning's 
horoscope?

text_block_list.name: Young Lala
text_block_list.text:
Of course! The lucky item is "something 
red," right? So that means—

text_block_list.name: Young Lala
text_block_list.text:
Ta-daaa! Red shoes!! I asked my mom to 
bring 'em out for me!

text_block_list.name: Young Lala
text_block_list.text:
Oh no...! I've seen three black license 
plates now! At this rate, bad luck's 
definitely comin' my way...!

text_block_list.name: Young Lala
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta square things right away! 
Where... Where is it—

text_block_list.name: Young Lala's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there she is! Lala-chaaan! She stopped 
in front of the candy shop--!!

text_block_list.name: Young Lala
text_block_list.text:
For real?! Wait for me, my yellow license 
plate of happiness--!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
“—That happened too, didn't it? Takes me 
back...”

"It was a side of her I had never seen 
before. Surprisingly, she might have a bit 
of a down-to-earth side to her as well."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
We ended up chatting for quite a while, 
didn't we? It's getting late, so why don't 
we take the train back?

On the way back. If I could hear more 
stories about her past, would I get to see 
a new side of her? Just as I was thinking 
that—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Ham-ham-ham-ham-hambuuuurg steak♪

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh!? You heard that? Ugh, that's so 
embarrassing......"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
No, well... it's a commercial jingle for a 
hamburg steak place that was popular when 
I was a kid...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I just happened to catch sight of the sign 
through the window, so I couldn't 
resist...
choice_data_list: Huh, so it was a popular shop.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Well, even if it was popular, it was just 
the song. There weren't any of those 
stores in my neighborhood.
choice_data_list: So, you've never eaten it before?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but while I was singing, I started 
worrying about the shop...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I threw a tantrum, and my parents took me 
right away.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Like takin' the train out to the next 
town like this, for example..."
choice_data_list:
I'm surprised to see you have a side like 
that.

I'm surprised to see you have a side like 
that.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
You know how there are all kinds of 
trends? Like school rumors, or things 
featured in magazines and TV that suddenly 
blow up in popularity.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I've always been sensitive to that kind of 
thing.

Believing in fortunes and enjoying 
whatever's trendy. Seeing her like that— I 
can't help but feel a sense of closeness 
with her.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —...And yes, there was a time like that!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that's not how it is now. After 
all, I'm aiming to be the star of the 
show."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
You've got to straighten up. Otherwise, 
you'll lose face, won't you?

She used to be so sensitive to trends... 
Indeed, seeing her present dignified 
demeanor, there's hardly a trace of those 
days left—

Could it be somewhat palpable? In fact, 
today, having learned about her past, she 
felt somehow more approachable.
choice_data_list:
Still, I'd love to have some time together 
like today again.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Although I can't say it every 
time...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Once in a while... I'd love to spend some 
relaxing time together again."

Her values might actually be closer to 
home than I originally thought.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Geez... I told you that was just a 
coincidence, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, if it's just a lucky item, it 
doesn't have much to do with aiming for 
the spotlight anyway."

Though feeling slightly brushed off, she 
had a point. Best not to dwell on it too 
much for now.
